description:
Remove the obsolete per-package `profile_applied` event from the current product contract so the aggregate lifecycle has one event representation.

## Background

The lifecycle now emits one `profile_lifecycle` event per operation, but the old `ProfileApplied` variant remains in the typed event enum, generated catalog/schema, parser marker handling, documentation, and tests. The repository is greenfield and `@/inv/canonical-cutover` permits no compatibility path without a named migration boundary. Generic unknown-event retention is sufficient; no event-specific compatibility or migration is required.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The `ProfileApplied` variant and `profile_applied` tag are absent from the current typed event vocabulary, generated catalog/schema, and adopter documentation.
- [hard] REQ-02: Torn-tail certification and all current profile audit tests use only the aggregate `ProfileLifecycle` event without weakening recovery or audit semantics.
- [hard] REQ-03: Mechanical cutover coverage fails if the retired variant, tag, or constructor reappears in production or generated lifecycle contracts.
- [hard] REQ-04: No migration, compatibility adapter, or profile-specific retired-event decoder is introduced; generic unknown-event behavior remains generic.
title: Remove the superseded profile_applied event contract
